verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents custom templates that capture a machine's configuration and can be used to create new machines with your specifications (docs-3, docs-36), and template choice is part of machine creation (docs-25). Full root access lets you build that environment (docs-12), and Deployments run container images (docs-8). Hands-on reports show users installing their own software stacks on VMs (comm-3, comm-9). missing for 10: detailed docs on the template capture/reuse workflow, evidence of bringing a custom Docker image to Notebooks/Machines (container images are only documented for model-serving Deployments), independent corroboration of custom templates specifically.
